SPACE RESCUE: BASIC lines 40-60 ask Y or N for instructions. If Y, a key is needed to leave the help screen. Lines 150-210 then ask for three nonnegative energy amounts: engines, life support, and shields. The combined amount must fit the energy shown on screen. Later choices for landing appear only after reaching orbit.

We ran RESCUE.tzx in Fuse 48K at 400% speed. Wait 9 seconds for the tape, press Enter, wait 0.5 seconds, press R and Enter, and wait 1.2 seconds. Enter N and Return, wait 0.7 seconds. Enter 100 for engines, 150 for life support, and 150 for shields, pressing Return after each. Wait 0.6 seconds between the first two amounts and 2.5 seconds after the last. Each key is held 0.08 seconds with 0.16 seconds released. We captured the start and trip event; the hazards may vary between runs.
